ActorTalk: Journalists are the lookouts at the ship's bow, and F.O.S., this great vessel, has now run aground—we absolutely cannot stand by and do nothing!
No matter how many obstacles lie ahead, I swear to bring the truth that everyone cares about to light!
Director... I'll always stand by you!
And that so-called intelligence society is gaining more and more credibility among the students! If this keeps up, our department's weekly is done for!
...I'd like a refund for my admiration.
They just got lucky—somehow got hold of oral testimony records from an eyewitness who was present at the Night of F.O.S. Apparently they also claimed that the incident was connected to M.I.N.D.?

I used our department funds to buy the highest-level access materials and tracked down the identity of that eyewitness. That student dropped out after the Night of F.O.S. due to a severe nervous breakdown—what credibility could their words possibly have?
Wait, did we just hand over our entire department budget to our competitors?
Just wait and see—I'll personally dig up the dirt on this so-called HiJack Intelligence Agency! I can tell this agency was sketchy just from the name!
